metadata.description: Open agent skills by Ian Balina: playbooks AI agents can run end to end, starting with fundraising.

plugins.name: fundraising
plugins.description: Run a capital raise or business sale end to end: startup seed and venture rounds, GP fund raises from LPs, and company M&A or strategic exits, run as one competitive process with human checkpoints.

plugins.name: first-principles-thinking
plugins.description: Reason from first principles instead of by analogy: strip a decision, design, cost, or strategy to fundamental truths with named evidence, price the raw inputs where money is involved, and rebuild a better option from the floor up.
